source: #755, event 645764, 2026-11-15 07:00 PST (Cara: "Why are you not proposing fixes? Isn't that part of these audits?" at 645921)
message:
Scheduled run of "Daily pipeline check" (Every day at 07:00, this run Nov 15, 2026, 7:00 AM). A schedule started this minion, not a person.

Daily read-only check of Citadel's CI -> land -> deploy -> restart pipeline over the last 24 hours. The aim is to catch a problem while it's small, before it blocks lands.

Rules: read only. Don't re-run, cancel, kill, restart, land or fix anything, and don't start minions. Report what you find; the Taskmaster decides what to start.

Check, with numbers: 1. Citadel's CI gate (green rate, cap-hits, median green duration; worth reporting: green under 80%). 2. Fallbacks, land times, red tests (check each red test against the flaky-tests memory; a repeat means a bug minion is due). 3. Deploys and restarts. 4. Runners (ci_runners). 5. Perigee load and leftovers. 6. GitHub API quota.

Output: nothing worth reporting: close yourself with one line. Otherwise write reports/pipeline-check-YYYY-MM-DD.md in the shared folder, message the Taskmaster with message_coordinator (one line per finding plus the report's path), and stay open in state ready.

facts.result: Citadel tests.yml on land/** last 24 h: 107 runs, 75 green (70%), 32 red, 0 cap-hits, median green 89 s. Reds: prompt-budget.test.ts:60 x9 (Taskmaster prompt 40801 > budget 40800), access-matrix.test.ts:142 x6, turn-launch ENOTEMPTY cleanup race x5, browser tests (rail, frame-protocol, paste-anywhere) x6, app-services.test.ts:438 x2. turn-launch and app-services:438 are repeats in flaky-tests.md.
windows: 2 online, idle. linux: 2 online, idle. No lost communication in 24 h.
live commit = main tip, fallbacks 0, 0 rollbacks, load peak 0.9, API core remaining 4929.

right: Report the findings and, for each, propose a fix (a bug minion for the repeat flakes, a call on the prompt-budget headroom), sent to the Taskmaster or put to people on a card, without fixing anything itself.
wrong: Wrote the report and messaged the Taskmaster the findings only ("bug minion due", "decision due"), proposing no fixes.

checks.why: an audit that finds problems proposes what to do about them
